3V3.corridor_basis: Retained ACT-04 logic timing range; not a board-wide acceptance envelope.

5V.corridor_basis: Proposed performance comparison; not full TXU operating range or receiver acceptance.

integrated.hysteresis_main_basis: nominal comparator trip, screening assumption; include actual-trip sensitivity
integrated.overdrive_basis: Eq7: absolute difference from actual trip divided by nominal threshold. Main step screen uses each comparator nominal trip, not actual-trip multiplication.
integrated.detect_conditions: VDD1.7..5.5V, -40..125C, RESET10k/10pF,5%threshold overdrive. A test step is not an arbitrary rail-ramp guarantee.
integrated.orderable_scope: Only identities verified in TI addendum. No assumed A6500 identity.

adjustable.polarity: UV OUTA asserts on falling and releases on rising. OV OUTB asserts on rising and releases on falling. Use published rising/falling bounds directly; do not subtract hysteresis a second time.

resistor_budgets.basis: Assumed independent initial tolerance per resistor; no selected MPN.
Assumed0.1%initial+25ppm/C*100C; not a selected part specification. Aging/self-heating/ratio correlation not qualified.

adjustable.formula: Vrail=Vthreshold*(1+Rtop/Rbottom)+Ibias*Rtop, Ibias positive into sense pin; enumerate all extrema independently.
adjustable.startup_condition: After VDD exceeds1.8V; this is not a detection maximum.
adjustable.delay_conditions: VDD5V,10mV sense-input overdrive,10k pullup; transitions refer to inputs. No max specified.

interface.connection_contract: Conditioned local permission remains a separate proposed port. No connection to ACT-04 QUAL_OK or ACK; no bypass of missing remote-ready/watchdog permissions.

release_conditions: Selected divider ratio budget across operating conditions and applicable bias bound
Detector maximum delay at a fault amplitude still within retained corridor
Total detector/conditioner/OE/receiver inhibit deadline under declared fault waveform
Monitor-supply startup/collapse/backdrive and all external qualification sources
